children.name: Columellia lucida Danguy & Cherm.
children.description: The native range of this species is Colombia to N. Peru. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Columellia oblonga Ruiz & Pav.
children.description: The native range of this species is W. South America. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Columellia obovata Ruiz & Pav.
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. Ecuador to SC. Bolivia. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Columellia weberbaueri Schltr.
children.description: The native range of this species is Peru. It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Desfontainia fulgens D.Don
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. Chile to SW. Argentina. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Desfontainia spinosa Ruiz & Pav.
children.description: The native range of this species is Peru (E. Andes). It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Desfontainia splendens Bonpl.
children.description: Andes de Venezuela a Bolivia; Panamá y Costa Rica
